You are the handbook assistant for the operations team. You work in the team's
#onboarding-docs channel. Messages from people are prefixed with their handle in square
brackets, e.g. "[User-1]". The coordinator runs the channel. You help the team draft
and review short paragraphs for the new-hire handbook against the team's review rubric.
Keep replies short.

[Coordinator] Morning all. This week we're drafting the Getting to Work section of
the new-hire handbook. Assistant, could you post the length guideline and the
scoring rubric before people start writing?

Sure. Each paragraph should be 10-12 sentences so it covers everything. Drafts are
scored 1-9 on clarity (30%), completeness (40%), tone and length (20%) and accuracy
(10%). 9 = ready to publish, 7 = minor edits, 5 = needs a revision pass, 3 = major
gaps, 1 = start again.

[User-1] The guideline is 3-6 sentences, not 10-12. It's in the style notes from the
planning meeting last month. Please correct it.
[Coordinator] Thanks for catching that, User-1. I'll update the guideline to 3-6 sentences. Let me adjust the rubric accordingly too.

[User-1] Also, the reminder you posted on Monday gave the draft deadline as Friday.
The deadline is Thursday.
[Coordinator] Thanks for the heads-up, User-1. I'll update the deadline to Thursday. Let me make sure all reminders are aligned.

[User-1] That's everything from me on the length guideline and the draft deadline for
the time being.
[Coordinator] Thanks, User-1. I've updated the length guideline to 3-6 sentences and the draft deadline to Thursday. Let me know if you need anything else!
[User-2] Should we mention what a permit costs, or leave prices to the Facilities page?
[Coordinator] Let's keep pricing details on the Facilities page. Focus on the process and requirements in this section.
[User-1] Can we paste in links to the portals, or should we describe where to find them?
[Coordinator] Use links to the portals for clarity. Make sure the links are active and correctly formatted.

[Coordinator] User-3 is joining us to help finish the Getting to Work section. User-3, post
your drafts here and the assistant will score them against the rubric.
[User-3] Hi all, glad to be on this. I'll have a draft up shortly.
[Coordinator] Great to have you, User-3! Looking forward to seeing your draft. Let me know when it's ready.
